sources.title: A bunch of Grand Theft Auto games will be cheap on Steam until GTA 6 comes out, and only one sucks
sources.text: In the run-up to GTA 6 's November 19 launch, Rockstar has multiple classic Grand Theft Auto games on sale on Steam – and, nearest I can tell, only on Steam. The Nintendo Switch eShop actually has a competing deal for the Grand Theft Auto Definitive Edition Trilogy, which is down 67% to $19.79, but that sale ends in 11 hours from the time of writing. On Steam, several GTA games are discounted until November 19 for an obviously timed special promotion. On Steam, you'll find four games on sale via two actual products: You can't argue with GTA 4 for $6, but you might argue with this version of, in particular, GTA 3. The Definitive Edition Trilogy was famously panned at launch for wonky graphics and poor technical performance that, for the most part, has been patched up in the years since. However, the PC port for GTA 3's Definitive Edition is uniquely poorly rated for reasons that will sound familiar. Here's how the three games in this trilogy compare in Steam reviews: The reception to the two other games in the trilogy improved over time while GTA 3 steadily declined. Much like the day-one reviews, today's Steam players complain of Rockstar launcher interference, bugs, shoddy art, broken cinematics, and performance dips. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more Curiously, perhaps unrelated to the quality of the port, some of today's gamers also don't seem to take too kindly to GTA 3's design sensibilities, it being slightly older than Vice City and San Andreas, and certainly a rawer open-world experience. Thomas Williamson, the CEO of the outsourced trilogy's original developer, Grove Street Games, said earlier this year that the criticism faced at launch was deserved. "I agreed with most of the people's reactions," he said. "But unfortunately, I feel like we did not agree with how the game was released and the response to it from a development side. And I think that would have changed the narrative significantly." However, he added, "at the end of the day, looking at the behind-the-scenes metrics on those games, there were a lot of people who were playing them and really enjoying them." You won't find Grove Street Games listed on the store pages for these games anymore. Previously, Williamson called it a "dick move" for Rockstar to have Grove Street's name removed. GTA 6 being pirated is just "a fact of life," says CEO of Rockstar owner, and lawyers are ready if it becomes a problem Austin has been a game journalist for 12 years, having freelanced for the likes of PC Gamer, Eurogamer, IGN, Sports Illustrated, and more while finishing his journalism degree. He's been with GamesRadar+ since 2019. They've yet to realize his position is a cover for his career-spanning Destiny column, and he's kept the ruse going with a lot of news and the occasional feature, all while playing as many roguelikes as possible. sources.title: Rockstar's having a sale on old GTA games on the only platform Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't coming to (ours)
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 finally arrives on November 19, but not for us, no—the big day is only for gamers on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. We're not being completely excluded, though: We can't have GTA 6 in November, but we can take advantage of pre-release discounts on a bunch of older GTA games—deals that, ironically, don't appear to be available on consoles. As noted by GamesRadar , there are four GTA games available in two releases: Grand Theft Auto 3, Vice City, and San Andreas bundled up in the GTA Trilogy for $19.79/£19.79/€19.79—67% off the regular price—and Grand Theft Auto 4: Complete Edition , which includes The Lost and Damned and The Ballad of Gay Tony expansions, for $6/£5.09/€6, a 70% discount. Those aren't the deepest discounts ever seen, but Grand Theft Auto games typically don't venture into the 90% off territory we all enjoy so much—and according to Isthereanydeal.com, this is as low as the GTA Trilogy has ever gone, and close to the mark for GTA 4 . You may recall that the GTA Trilogy Definitive Edition was a mess when it launched in 2021, but it seems to have turned that frown upside-down since then: On Steam, where the trilogy arrived in 2023, Vice City and San Andreas both hold "very positive" ratings. GTA 3 is stuck at a "mixed" rating, which is unfortunate: Glancing at user reviews, it sounds like the game still isn't in perfect shape, but it's also suffering from the fact that it's 25 years old, and was the first 3D game in the series—some jank and roughness was there right from the start. Grand Theft Auto 4: The Complete Edition, on the other hand, doesn't suffer from those shortcomings. It's getting pretty long in the tooth too—it came out in 2008—but represents a shift in design and tone that led the series into what it is today. If you're looking for just one older GTA game to horse around with, this is the one, especially given that it's less than half the cost of the trilogy. As mentioned, these sale prices are currently only being offered on Steam: There's currently no sign of any of them on either the Xbox or PlayStation stores (Fun fact: there actually is no digital version of GTA 4 on the PS Store because Sony didn't start selling full-priced games online until well after 2008). Maybe it's just coincidence, but they do appear to be intentional pre-GTA 6 sales: The discounts are on until November 19, when Grand Theft Auto 6 launches—except on PC. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Square Enix accidentally botches a Nier: Automata update, balloons required file size from 50GB to 366GB on PC
sources.text: "Do you think games are silly little things?" Yesterday, Nier: Automata received a new patch on Steam, adding more language support to the title - it can now be played with Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese options - but this new update also, somehow, inflated the file size of the game on PC from about 50GB to 366GB. D'oh! What's worse is, the update is not optional. The cause of this, reportedly, is a bug that caused all the DLC in the YoRHa Edition of the game to become the same size as the base game - and the new download stacks them all concurrently. "Only SquareEnix can turn 40GB into 366GB with 8GB patch," says one dissatisfied Steam reviewer. If you don't have space for this massive new file on your PC (and I can't say I blame you, it's ridiculous), there is a workaround, as confirmed by Square Enix in a tweet via its Japanese Twitter account . "We have confirmed an issue where, following the latest update to the Steam version of Nier: Automata, the installation process indicates that more storage space is required than expected," noted the publisher. "We are currently investigating the cause and working on a solution. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. As a temporary workaround, you can download the base game by unchecking the DLC under Steam → Properties → DLC." It's quite ironic, really, that so many Steam reviewers are complaining about things like "I just need to delete 90% of my computer to install this" when a large part of the game is managing the software/programmes installed on your android protagonists in order to upgrade your abilities and stats. There's even an ending for uninstalling your OS on your mechanical main characters. I'd be inclined to suggest this is some sort of meta psy-op from creator Yoko Taro , but… nah, that's just fantasy, isn't it? Isn't it? Speaking of Taro, earlier this year we learned that " Nier Automata will continue ", though we only heard back in 2025 tha t most of the projects the developer was working on were cancelled . One of these may have been the Tencent -backed Nier mobile game in 2024, which reportedly "struggled to find a monetisation to offset its high costs ."

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Nier: Automata developer is 'currently investigating' a bizarre update bug that drastically inflated the game's file size from 50GB to 366GB
sources.text: Square Enix is 'working to resolve the issue'. Usually, it's a good thing when a patch makes an already excellent game substantially larger. But in the case of Nier: Automata 's most recent update, bigger is most certainly not better. On Friday, the beloved action RPG from Square Enix received what should have been a straightforward update to added localisation support for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean languages. But as reported by Automaton Media, the update also increased the game's file size from 50 gigabytes to a staggering 366 (and a half) gigabytes. "We have identified an issue following the latest update for Nier: Automata … where installation requires significantly more storage space than intended," wrote Square Enix in a Steam post . "We are currently investigating the cause and working to resolve the issue. We apologise for the inconvenience." It isn't clear how this issue has occurred, but it may be related to Nier: Automata's DLC. When selected for download on Steam, each DLC appears to have the same file size as the base game. Weirdly though, this is only true for the initial download and installation. Once the game is installed, the file reportedly reverts to a more appropriate size of roughly 50 gigs. Indeed, as a temporary solution, Square Enix suggests that anyone who needs to download Nier: Automata deselects all eight DLC when they do so. "As a temporary workaround, you can download the base game using the intended amount of storage space by going to "Properties" à "DLC" in Steam and unchecking each DLC item." While 366 gigabytes is obviously a ridiculous size for a game, what's frightening to me is that games are on track to become that massive in the coming years. Big budget games regularly exceed the 100 gigabytes in file size these days, while several major titles like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, have surpassed 200GB. One of the largest reported installations to date is for the combat simulator DCS World , which had a maximum file size of 250GB back in 2021 . So although Nier: Automata's SSD-choking file-size is an accidental anomaly, it might also be an ominous glimpse into the future of PC gaming. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. sources.text: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is officially out in the world (and we really loved it ). If you don't have a copy yet for your Nintendo Switch 2 and are dying to jump in, Costco can help you out as it's currently offering digital copies for $54.99 . There's a catch, though: this offer is only available to Costco members. But if that's you, then you can score a nice little $5 discount on this game right after launch day. Just make sure you're logged into your account before you head to checkout so you can take advantage of this offer while it's still available. No matter if you have fond memories of the original or if it's your first time playing, you're in for a wonderful time with this remake if you decide to buy it. IGN's Logan Plant had heaps of praise for it in his 9/10 review , writing that "Nintendo skillfully melds the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own." If you're a Costco member, this is a nice way to save a little cash on this brand new launch. sources.title: You Can’t Cheat At The Chicken Game Anymore In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time
sources.text: Nintendo Switch 2 The Legend of Zelda The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time I’d forgotten already (despite playing the original very recently) that Ocarina of Time has aÂ lot of minigames all over the place. There’s Bombchu Bowling (which everyone remembers for its apparently very hot attendant), a game about guessing which chest has a rupee in it, a fishing game, a shooting gallery, and some other stuff. There’s also a simplistic chicken game that rewards you with a precious bottle filled with Lon Lon Milk. You used to be able to very easily cheat at this game and win it on the first go. Now, in the remake, you can’t. It’s easy to cheat at the Cucco minigame at Lon Lon Ranch in the original Ocarina of Time . The goal of the game is to find three special Cuccos in a big flock of identical ones inside Talon’s house. Playing normally can take a couple of tries, as you’re given a time limit, and there’s no way of knowing which Cucco is which. And it costs money to play each time, which early in the game can hurt Link’s little baby wallet. But you can cheat by picking up each Cucco in the houseÂ before the minigame starts, and dumping it into the corner behind Talon next to the stairs. The Cuccos will stay back there, so when Talon releases his three special ones, they just sit in the middle of the floor alone and it’s obvious which ones are which. In the remake, this cheat is gone. Not only can you not get the Cuccos stuck back in that corner anymore (I tried chucking every single one up the stairs, that didn’t work either, they just slid down), but Talon actively shuffles the Cuccos in the whole room when you prompt him to start the game, putting each one back on the floor again. Fortunately, picking up and putting down Cuccos is much faster with the Switch 2 version’s smooth controls, so it’s easier than ever to just…win at this game the first time, no cheating required. I’ve noticed some other little changes, too, that get rid of well-known little “exploits” if you will. You can’t climb the chains on the drawbridge of Hyrule Castle to collect rupees anymoreâyou just fall straight through them. On the other hand, some little tricks are still in place. For instance, you can apparently still hit butterflies with a Deku stick to turn them into fairies. I didn’t even know you could do that in the original: Yessss!! they kept one of my favorite feature from the OG Ocarina of Time. You can turn butterflies into fairies if you hit them with a deku stick!!! pic.twitter.com/yYszJuB58A — Riz. ðµð¸ (@Rizkhalifa449) November 5, 2026 And, I hear tell you can still do some of the dungeons out of order: [OoTHD] I tested the remake to see if it was still possible to do [SPOILERS] by u/Hal_Keaton in zelda I haven’t gotten there yet, but I’m assuming you’ll still be able to use the Lens of Truth (or Goggles, as I guess they are now) to cheat at the Chest Minigame. Now if only I could also somehow cheat at the shooting gallery… Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. Could a remake of the other (better) Nintendo 64 Zelda also be on the way? stories.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
stories.summary: The post Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais appeared first on Xbox Wire em Português .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
sources.text: A atualização mais pedida de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla já está disponível no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One. A atualização traz diversas novidades empolgantes ao jogo, oferecendo novas maneiras de aproveitar sua aventura viking. O grande destaque é a chegada do Novo Jogo+, um dos recursos mais pedidos pelos fãs de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla . As demais novidades do patch garantem que sua experiência após o fim da campanha e no Novo Jogo+ seja renovada e desafiadora, com recompensas que fazem tudo valer a pena. Confira o que esperar da atualização mais pedida: Conversamos com o designer-chefe de jogo, David Larouche, para saber mais sobre a atualização e como a equipe coloca os jogadores no centro de tudo o que faz. Quais novidades desta atualização são uma resposta direta aos comentários da comunidade? David Larouche : o Novo Jogo+ foi, sem dúvida, o recurso mais pedido pelos fãs. Assassin’s Creed Valhalla é um jogo imenso, mas, para algumas pessoas, jogar uma vez só não basta. Com esta atualização, estamos muito empolgados em permitir que nossos vikings mais dedicados vivam essa aventura novamente, mas, desta vez, com o personagem que tinham ao final da campanha. Como a equipe garantiu que os recursos pedidos atendessem às expectativas dos jogadores? DL : queríamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ não fosse apenas jogar tudo de novo; queríamos permitir que os jogadores continuassem aumentando seu poder, percebessem uma progressão em etapas menores e seguissem aprimorando seus personagens. Por todos esses motivos, adicionamos um modo de progressão estendida, mais melhorias para todas as peças de equipamento divino, uma nova categoria de runas e mais de 300 novas opções de bônus de runas que podem ser gravados na Forja de Runas — e todos esses recursos também estão disponíveis fora do Novo Jogo+. Com todas essas novidades, acreditamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ incentivará os jogadores a explorar todo o potencial de Eivor. Houve algum desafio inesperado na implementação dessas novidades? DL : acho que o mais surpreendente para nós foi justamente não termos encontrado nenhum grande desafio que nos deixasse sem saber como avançar. Conseguimos reunir uma equipe muito competente de desenvolvedores com experiência em adicionar o Novo Jogo+ a jogos já existentes; o processo de produção foi incrivelmente tranquilo. Há algum recurso que você esteja especialmente empolgado para ver no jogo? DL : com a atualização, transformamos praticamente todos os bônus presentes em itens em runas que podem ser gravadas na Forja de Runas, independentemente de terem sido lançados na experiência estendida, em uma expansão ou até mesmo na Loja. Mal posso esperar para ver como os jogadores vão combinar todos esses bônus e criar os mais variados tipos de sinergia. Tenho certeza de que há muitas combinações poderosíssimas a serem descobertas! Assassin’s Creed Valhalla recebeu sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos. Por que lançar a atualização mais pedida para os jogadores agora? DL : Valhalla pode ter recebido sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos, mas isso não significa que os jogadores deixaram de se importar com o jogo — e nós também não. Sabemos que o Novo Jogo+ é algo que a comunidade deseja há muito tempo e, quando surgiu a oportunidade de finalmente torná-lo realidade, mal podíamos esperar para seguir em frente. No fim das contas, trata-se de dar aos jogadores de longa data mais um motivo para voltar a um mundo ao qual dedicaram tanto tempo e reviver a jornada de Eivor sob uma nova perspectiva, levando consigo boa parte do que conquistaram pelo caminho. O fato de algum tempo ter passado não torna essa experiência menos significativa para nós nem, esperamos, para nossos jogadores. Qual é a importância da comunidade de Assassin’s Creed para a equipe da franquia? DL : a comunidade é extremamente importante para mim e para a equipe. Pessoalmente, acompanho as redes sociais com frequência para ver sobre o que os jogadores estão conversando e, como equipe, prestamos muita atenção aos comentários e às conversas pela internet. Adoramos ver o que os jogadores criam e compartilham sobre nossos jogos. Essa conexão com a comunidade é incrivelmente gratificante e é uma das principais razões pelas quais fazemos o que fazemos. Jogue hoje mesmo Assassin’s Creed Valhalla com a atualização mais pedida no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One.

sources.title: Nintendo says it’s not planning another Switch 2 price hike
sources.text: Nintendo’s president says it will have ‘sufficient’ RAM as shortages drive up console prices.﻿ Nintendo’s president says it will have ‘sufficient’ RAM as shortages drive up console prices.﻿ Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said during the company’s latest earnings call that it’s “not considering additional changes” to the Switch 2’s price, Reuters reports. The Switch 2 got a $50 price hike earlier this year, bringing its starting price up to $499. Nintendo said in Thursday’s earnings report that Switch 2 sales have dropped 37.4 percent year-over-year. According to Reuters , Furukawa also gave an update on the RAM shortage, saying, “There has been no major change to the memory situation and Nintendo is in a position to secure sufficient quantities.” Earlier this week, one of Nintendo’s Switch 2 cartridge suppliers announced it plans to stop making ROM memory to focus on memory for data centers instead. Demand from AI data centers is driving the ongoing RAM shortages that’s leading to a wave of tech price increases. Microsoft has raised Xbox Series X / S prices multiple times now, increasing the Series S’s starting price from $299 to $499. The PS5 has also been hit with price hikes, taking its starting price up to $649 .

sources.text: Wild West-themed turn-based strategy game sequel Hard West II will launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 10, publisher Klabater and developer Ice Code Games announced. Hard West II first launched for PC via Steam on August 4, 2022. Here is an overview of the game, via Klabater: Hard West II takes players deep into unforgiving wastelands, where revolver bullets collide with dark magic drawn straight from forgotten tales. Discover the story of Gin Carter, a legendary outlaw who sets out on a mission to rob the mysterious “Ghost Train.” However, it soon becomes clear that gold will not be your main objective—instead, you will face the task of reclaiming your own soul. To achieve this, together with your posse you will travel across the diverse lands of the Weird West , fighting a variety of enemies and taking part in duels, train robberies, and horseback chases. In Hard West II , the main focus is on tactical, turn-based combat, in which the player commands a group of gunslingers, each with unique abilities developed through creating special combinations of mysterious cards. An important gameplay element is the Bravado mechanic, which grants additional action points after defeating enemies and allows you to chain your companions’ actions into spectacular kill sequences.

sources.title: Three Games You Can Play For Free This Weekend On PC
sources.text: Epic Games Store Free Humble Bundle Steam It’s Friday! Welcome to the weekend. We made it. Halloween. Election day. The launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. We survived. I’m about to go pick up Chinese takeout for my family, but before I do, here are some good deals on PC games to kick things off in November. First, we have games that are temporarily free on Steam. Payday 3 , which remains in recovery mode after its terrible launch, is yours to try risk-free until November 9. You can go download it, grab some friends, and try to pull off a few heists without spending a dime. “Launched badly, but it’s slowly taking a turn for the better,” one Steam reviewer recently posted. “To me personally, I love it now, but I can also see that it needs some more spice to give it enough kick for everyone. Will keep supporting and keep genuinely hoping that it could pull a Cyberpunk 2077 moment.” Second, we have Age of Wonders 4 , a generally quite good 4X strategy RPG. It’s also available to play for free until November 9. If you want a fantasy game that mixes empire building with fun tactical battles, Age of Wonders 4 strikes a pretty good balance. Players are still encountering bugs and multiplayer issues, but if you just want to settle in for some cozy city building and battles and have a PC with an Nvidia GeForce GTX 670 card or better, it’s a good deal. Moving over to the Epic Games Store, floating city management sim Flotsam is free to claim until November 12. It’s a feel-good post-apocalyptic game about salvaging debris, meeting fellow survivors, and combing through skill trees to help rebuild civilization. It’s vibrant, chill, and normally $25. And unlike Age of Wonders 4 and Payday 3 , it’ll be yours to keep. If you haven’t already played it, this one’s worth having in your library. Finally, a bonus round. I don’t usually recommend Humble Bundle’s monthly subscription , but the games for November are wroth a look. If you’re willing to sign-up, members this month are getting PC keys for Mafia: The Old Country , The Outer Worlds 2 , Shinobi: Art of Vengeance , and a bunch more games. Those three alone are well worth it, but horror shooter Crisol: Theater of Idols , which only released back in February, is also part of the mix. You can read our review of it here . especial_gta6.tema: Armas e combate em GTA 6: mira livre, câmera lenta e tiros que não matam
especial_gta6.angulo: O que muda na hora do tiroteio em GTA 6 em relação a GTA 5 e quais armas já foram vistas, para quem quer chegar no dia 19/11 sabendo como o combate funciona.

fatos.texto: A mira automática vem desligada por padrão; o jogo aposta na mira livre, com um leve 'grude' no alvo que pode ser ajustado nas configurações.
As armas têm mais recuo e peso do que em GTA 5; fuzis pedem rajadas curtas para acertar.
O tiroteio é baseado em cobertura: no Extended Look, Jason se protege atrás de paredes antes de atirar.
Há um modo de câmera lenta, no estilo do Dead Eye de Red Dead Redemption 2, que destaca pontos fracos do inimigo, como cabeça, mãos e articulações.
Dá para incapacitar inimigos sem matar, atirando em braços e pernas, e até arrancar a arma da mão deles com um tiro.
Atos muito violentos podem acionar câmeras cinematográficas em câmera lenta (kill cams), opcionais.
Dá para ameaçar alguém com a arma sem atirar e evitar que a situação escale.
Pedestres podem andar armados, reagir ao crime e até começar brigas sem provocação; Rob Nelson resumiu que o jogador não é o único com armas nem o único capaz de violência.
Carregar um fuzil nas costas não assusta ninguém; apontar a arma para as pessoas faz elas fugirem ou chamarem a polícia.
Jason usa a pistola Girardi ES9 e Lucia a Klose K17; versões personalizadas das duas vêm na Ultimate Edition.
A Ultimate Edition inclui os revólveres Hawk & Little Morgan e variantes personalizadas de armas; o pacote de pré-venda Vintage Vice City traz uma estampa exclusiva de arma.
Também já foram vistos o revólver Mustang .357, o pequeno revólver Nipper .38 (que Lucia segura na arte de capa) e um fuzil da marca Duke.
O Trailer 2 mostrou uma loja Ammu-Nation com metralhadoras, fuzis e pistolas nas prateleiras e uma arma inspirada na submetralhadora MP5; Lucia usa um lança-granadas numa perseguição policial.
No Extended Look aparecem espingarda, pistolas e fuzis; Lucia atira com a espingarda usando uma mão só.
Na luta corpo a corpo da cena da festa, Lucia escapa de um agressor com comandos rápidos (quick-time events) e o fere com o salto do sapato.
Atirar nos pneus faz o motorista perder o controle e é uma das formas mais eficazes de parar perseguidores.
O Criminal Profile leva em conta o contexto: se defender não te transforma em criminoso; pesa quem exagera na violência de forma repetida.
